title: State Commission or National Commission Must Make Orders on Costs of Adjournment

content.scenario: The State Commission grants an adjournment in an appeal hearing and imposes costs on the respondent. The respondent, Ramesh, requests the Commission to specify the costs.
content.outcome: The State Commission or National Commission must make orders as to the costs occasioned by the adjournment, as specified by regulations, under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What are the costs for adjournment?
How are costs for adjournment determined?
Can the State Commission waive costs for adjournment?
